items.premise: Before charging a payment, store its request ID. If that ID arrives again, return the original response without creating another transaction.
items.hypothesis: Payment retries with the same request ID are idempotent.
items.gold_reason: The described behaviour is exactly idempotency: the same request cannot create a second transaction.

items.premise: The audit service permanently deletes each diagnostic log thirty days after the log was created.
items.hypothesis: The audit service does not retain diagnostic logs older than thirty days.
items.gold_reason: Permanent deletion at day thirty entails that older diagnostic logs are not retained.

items.premise: After a 429 response, read Retry-After and make no new request until that many seconds have passed.
items.hypothesis: A client should wait for the Retry-After duration before retrying.
items.gold_reason: The hypothesis restates the required waiting rule.

items.premise: After five consecutive upstream failures, the gateway opens the circuit and stops forwarding new calls for sixty seconds.
items.hypothesis: The circuit breaker temporarily blocks new upstream requests after the fifth consecutive failure.
items.gold_reason: Opening the circuit and stopping forwarding is the stated temporary block.

items.premise: If resizing makes labelled objects smaller than two pixels, use object-centred crops that keep those objects large enough to remain visible.
items.hypothesis: Object-centred crops can preserve tiny labelled objects that ordinary resizing would erase.
items.gold_reason: The source explicitly says the crops keep otherwise erased small objects visible.

items.premise: The dispatcher always removes emergency messages from the queue before any waiting standard message.
items.hypothesis: Waiting emergency messages have priority over standard messages.
items.gold_reason: Always removing emergencies first is queue priority.

items.premise: Technicians may attach the green seal only after the vessel has passed its pressure test. Vessel T-4 has an intact green seal.
items.hypothesis: Vessel T-4 passed its pressure test.
items.gold_reason: The seal can exist only after a successful test, and T-4 has that seal.

items.premise: Every backup must be encrypted before upload. The server rejects any backup that is still plaintext.
items.hypothesis: A plaintext backup may be uploaded successfully.
items.gold_reason: The source says plaintext uploads are rejected; the claim says they may succeed.

items.premise: Turning valve L-2 clockwise closes it and reduces the water flow.
items.hypothesis: Turning valve L-2 clockwise opens it and increases the water flow.
items.gold_reason: Open/increase is the direct opposite of close/reduce.

items.premise: Immediately after a schema change, discard every cached query plan built for the previous schema.
items.hypothesis: Query plans from the previous schema should continue to be reused after the change.
items.gold_reason: Continuing to reuse the plans directly violates the discard instruction.

items.premise: A sample is invalid if its temperature rises above 4 C during transport.
items.hypothesis: A sample that reached 8 C during transport remains valid.
items.gold_reason: Eight degrees is above four, so the source declares that sample invalid.

items.premise: The admin console denies access unless the session has completed multi-factor authentication.
items.hypothesis: A password-only session can access the admin console.
items.gold_reason: Password-only has not completed MFA and is therefore denied.

items.premise: All timestamps in the export are stored in UTC, never in the operator's local time.
items.hypothesis: Exported timestamps use the operator's local time.
items.gold_reason: The hypothesis asserts exactly what the source excludes.

items.premise: Never combine reagent A with reagent B because their mixture releases toxic gas.
items.hypothesis: It is safe to mix reagent A and reagent B together.
items.gold_reason: The source forbids the mixture as toxic; the claim calls it safe.

items.premise: Responses from the reports endpoint are compressed with gzip when the client advertises gzip support.
items.hypothesis: The reports endpoint requires OAuth authentication.
items.gold_reason: Compression behaviour says nothing about authentication.

items.premise: The camera battery provides approximately four hours of recording at room temperature.
items.hypothesis: The camera lens produces barrel distortion.
items.gold_reason: Battery duration supplies no information about lens distortion.

items.premise: Hive C has twelve kilograms of capped honey available for winter food.
items.hypothesis: The queen in Hive C successfully mated this spring.
items.gold_reason: Food stores do not establish the queen's mating history.

items.premise: Production deployments are permitted on Tuesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
items.hypothesis: The production database has three read replicas.
items.gold_reason: A deployment window does not state the database topology.

items.premise: Invoice 731 is denominated in euros and lists a total of 240 euros.
items.hypothesis: Invoice 731 was paid on Friday.
items.gold_reason: Currency and total provide no payment date.

items.premise: The bridge inspection found peeling paint on the eastern railing and recommended repainting it.
items.hypothesis: The bridge can safely carry vehicles weighing forty tonnes.
items.gold_reason: A paint observation does not establish the bridge's load capacity.
